# AuPro - Andhra University Student Portal
> Official student services, verified updates, campus maps, certificates, and academic portal for Andhra University College of Engineering (AUCOE).

## Core Features
- Student Announcements & Grievance Feed (Restricted to @andhrauniversity.edu.in)
- Google Maps GPS-Enabled Campus Navigation with Real-Time Auto-Tracking
- AI College Assistant for Hall Tickets, Bonafide Certificates, Bus Passes, and Office Timings
- College of Engineering Administrative Directory & Campus Landmarks
- One-Time Secure Email Verification (Passwordless Identity Auth)

## Domain Policy
- Official registration restricted strictly to @andhrauniversity.edu.in domain
- Zero student passwords stored: protected by HMAC-SHA256 one-time verification
